info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Finance Financial Statement By Financial Statement Id-v5-spec
info.description: The Update Financial Statement API allows businesses to modify existing financial statements identified by their unique ID. This endpoint is essential for finance teams to ensure the accuracy and currency of financial data, allowing for necessary adjustments to be made in a timely manner. Typical consumers of this API include financial analysts and accountants who need to keep financial records up-to-date. Utilizing this API, organizations can manage changes effectively, thus enhancing their financial reporting processes.

patch.description: This endpoint allows for the partial update of a specific financial statement identified by its unique resource ID. Ensure that you provide only the fields that need to be modified.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update financial statements for a specific resource identified by RES-100045. It requires a JSON payload containing the updated financial data.

200.description: Request completed successfully, with the updated financial statement data returned.
